summary: Full E2E retest of Stars Connection v2 (PHASE 1+2 rewrite). Backend: 20/20 pytest cases PASS — invite-only registration + reuse-403, public invite validation, admin invite generation, login (DDMMYYYY passwords), strict gender filter (Shakuntala only sees males including Shubham who is male/looking_for=male — reciprocity removed), no paywall on /api/matches or /api/kundali/* or /pdf, AstroSage report shape (8 birth_details rows, 8 ashtakoota rows with boy/girl/max/obtained/area, mangal_dosha_text starting with Mr./Ms., conclusion, 8 interpretations), full phone-request consent flow (create→idempotent→inbox→stranger-cannot-accept→accept→phone revealed in kundali; reject path; cannot self-request), and security (no field-leak via /profile to escalate to admin or modify is_premium/is_private_member). Frontend: Landing → Login → Dashboard (7 strict-male matches for Shakuntala, no blur/lock overlays) → Kundali (all 9 testids present: kundali-report, birth-details-table, ashtakoota-table with 9 rows = 8 gunas+total, mangal-dosha, conclusion, phone-request-section with disclaimer text, 8 interpretation children, disclaimer, download-pdf-button) → /invitations (generate-invite works, copy button appears) → /inbox (page renders, items listed). /invite/INVALIDXYZ shows 'Invalid' message and submit disabled.

minor.issue: FRONTEND_URL points to a different preview host (0999bfac-...emergentagent.com) than REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (astro-soulmate-4...). CORSMiddleware allow_origins is set to FRONTEND_URL only — same-origin ingress masks it today but cross-origin fetch with credentials would break. CORS_ORIGINS env var is defined but never read in server.py.
Returns 401 on landing/invite pages causing console error spam. Suggest guarding AuthContext bootstrap so it does not call /me on unauthenticated public routes.

issues: Browser <title> still 'Emergent | Fullstack App' — should be 'Stars Connection' (carryover from iteration_1, not yet fixed).

action_items: (Optional) Guard AuthContext bootstrap to skip /api/auth/me on public routes (/, /login, /invite/:code) to silence 401 console errors.
(Optional) Remove dead CORS_ORIGINS env var or actually read it; align FRONTEND_URL with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL host.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 667 lines — close to the 700-line guideline; consider splitting Phone Requests + Invites + Payments into their own routers.
Strict gender filter implemented in matching.py without reciprocity — verified at API: Shubham (male, looking_for=male) correctly appears in Shakuntala's (female, looking_for=male) match list.

/api/auth/register stores hashed password via bcrypt and only honors whitelisted fields — is_premium/role/is_private_member cannot be injected from client (Pydantic RegisterIn does not include them). /api/profile likewise ignores extra fields — verified at runtime that /auth/me returns role='user' after attempted privilege injection.
/api/phone-requests has unique compound index on (requester_user_id, receiver_user_id) and the route correctly returns the existing record on duplicate POST — idempotent and verified.
/api/kundali/:id no longer enforces a 402 — paywall removed as required. PDF endpoint also returns 200 application/pdf for any score.
Mongo _id properly excluded across responses (find_one with projection or via _public_user serializer / str(ObjectId) cast).
Phone consent flow correctly gates phone reveal: kundali response only includes other.phone when an accepted phone_number_request exists for (current_user → match).
